purpose: High-recall discovery queue. These records are research leads, not automatically validated facts or reusable reconstruction media.

leads.title: 315 Bowery, CBGB, ca. 1985 - DOF Tax Photo Collection
leads.value: Very high: official circa-1985 facade/building record tied to the address.
leads.rights_note: NYC Municipal Archives requires licensing for commercial publication/use; metadata/reference until permission obtained.
leads.next_action: Locate exact digital object for block 457 lot 5 and request publication/derivative-use terms if needed.

leads.title: NYC Municipal Archives 1940s Tax Department photographs
leads.value: High: pre-CBGB Palace Hotel/storefront and full-building facade state, parcel-indexed by block/lot.
leads.next_action: Search Manhattan series for block 457 lot 5 and compare 1940s facade/storefront to later Palace/CBGB states.

leads.title: NYC Department of Finance 1980s property tax photo collection
leads.value: Very high: standardized street-facing CBGB-era building photo likely near the 1985 example already surfaced.
leads.next_action: Obtain exact 313/315 Bowery image record and licensing terms.

leads.title: Peter Dougherty Collection, NYU Fales MSS.213
leads.value: Very high: sound/video/ephemera archive created by a frequent CBGB attendee and recorder.
examples: Television Live CBGB May 26 1976 - Media ID 213.0475
Television Live CBGB Jan 23 1976 - Media ID 213.0476
Television Live CBGB Mar 11 1976 - Media ID 213.0477
Suicide CBGB June 2 1979 second set - Media IDs 213.0042/213.0043
leads.next_action: Add exact CBGB items to archive index; request research access and determine rights holders before any media reuse.

leads.title: Joseph O. Holmes CBGB interior series, September 2006
leads.value: Exceptional: photographer states he spent 10 days photographing the quiet/empty club in September 2006, immediately before closure. This may be one of the best closing-era geometry sources available.
leads.next_action: Contact photographer/rightsholder about licensing a spatially useful subset or providing research-resolution wide shots.

leads.title: Q&A (1990) - CBGB interior/exterior filming location
leads.value: High geometry lead: production metadata says interior bar scenes and exterior were filmed at CBGB during 1989 production period.
leads.next_action: Verify scene/timecodes from legitimate viewing source; pursue studio rights only if frames need public display/derived use.

leads.title: Official CBGB history - CB's 313 Gallery
leads.value: High: says the record store was replaced in the late 1980s by a second performance/art gallery called CB's 313 Gallery.
leads.next_action: Resolve timeline, door connections and basement/ground-floor plans for 313 vs main 315 room.

leads.title: Former CBGB Gallery space up for grabs
leads.value: Medium-high: reports roughly 3,300 sq ft ground floor plus 5,500 sq ft basement for former 313 Gallery, next door to 315 club.
leads.next_action: Find original listing/floorplan or DOB plan rather than treating article dimensions as surveyed historical geometry.

leads.title: CBGB and CB's 313 Gallery, January 2 2006
leads.value: High: both 313 Gallery and 315 CBGB facade in the same closing-era view.
leads.rights_note: All rights reserved on Flickr result; reference-only until licensed.
leads.next_action: Request a display/reconstruction license if the image materially improves facade registration.

leads.title: Chris Frantz - The Two Sides of the Bowery
leads.value: Medium-high: first-person 1974 account includes club atmosphere, uneven floor and a pool-game area toward the back.
leads.next_action: Convert spatial details into low/medium-confidence observations and seek corroborating visual evidence.

leads.title: Palace Hotel / pre-CBGB 315 Bowery photographs
leads.value: High for pre-1973 state and inherited bar/storefront geometry.
leads.next_action: Trace the underlying image sources and rights rather than copying secondary-page illustrations.

leads.title: Library of Congress Sanborn Maps
leads.value: High: LOC states its online Sanborn Maps Collection is public domain; exact Manhattan sheet for block 457 still needs identification.
leads.next_action: Locate sheets covering Bowery/East 1st-East 2nd for relevant years and register building footprints/occupancies.

leads.title: Palace Renaissance, Inc. v. Sareb Restaurant Corp. d/b/a C.B.G.B.
leads.value: Medium: lease/dispute chronology, landlord/tenant structure and possible premises descriptions.
leads.next_action: Review pleadings/exhibits if publicly obtainable; flag any floor plans/lease descriptions for rights review.

leads.title: GRAMMY Museum - Celebrating CBGB's 50th Anniversary
leads.value: Medium: panel includes photographer Bob Gruen, Miriam Linna, former CBGB manager BG Hacker and other scene witnesses.
leads.next_action: Index layout/operations statements as oral-history observations; do not copy stream media.

leads.title: CBGB awning and related artifact leads at Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
leads.value: High if permissioned: surviving physical signage can be measured/photogrammetrically documented.
leads.next_action: Identify exact artifact catalog records and request research measurement/photo permission.

leads.title: NYC DOB records for BBL 1004570005 / BIN 1006536
leads.value: Very high: alteration/egress/floor-plan history may solve modern and post-closure geometry.
leads.next_action: Enumerate BIS/DOB NOW jobs, identify plan sets around 1934 (historic records), 2006-2009 conversion and later alterations.
